sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 328)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio and Armed Forces Radio Service (AFRS), three thrilling vigilante cases across a decade of *The Green Hornet* starring Al Hodge and Jack McCarthy (1939–1949), Jean Hersholt healing troubled souls in River's End on *Dr. Christian* for Vaseline (1945–1951), and Sonny Dunham's live big band broadcast from the Hotel New Yorker on AFRS *One Night Stand* (1939–1951):
